title: Alaska Coastal Explorer

services.name: Combo Fishing
services.desc: You don’t have to venture far outside of Seward to find yourself in the wild. Mountains tower over our picturesque little harbor, and just beyond the breakwall is the vast wilderness of Kenai Fjords. The national park boasts the Harding Ice field which feeds dozens of glaciers; some flowing to tidewater, others pouring into the sea through massive waterfalls along with snowmelt from the surrounding peaks. Thousands of seabirds congregate along the rocky shorelines, while whales, sea lions, otters, and seals swim beneath the surface of the waves.
